description: Non-mutating evidence commands required before switching nirs4all DEFAULT_ENGINE to dag-ml.

policy.cutover_condition: All required gates pass, coverage_meter.summary.fallback == 0, and no gate relies on implicit legacy fallback.

gates.title: PYREF fallback meter is empty
command: tmp=$(mktemp); PYTHONPATH={workspace_root}/dag-ml/crates/dag-ml-py/python:. PATH={workspace_root}/dag-ml/target/release:$PATH /home/delete/miniconda3/bin/python -m tests.integration.parity.coverage_meter --json "$tmp" --check && python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert d["summary"]["fallback"] == 0, d["summary"]' "$tmp"
evidence: coverage_meter --check passes
coverage_meter.summary.fallback == 0

gates.title: Full Python reference parity oracle
evidence: strict xfail inventory unchanged or intentionally updated
native boundary test is not xfailed
legacy vs dag-ml parity passes for every non-fallback runnable case

gates.title: Native .n4a export and cross-engine bundle parity
evidence: dag-ml native export does not call the legacy engine for supported native artifacts
legacy and dag-ml bundles load through the public predict path
unsupported export selectors fail before bridge materialization

gates.title: Studio route-level runtime adoption
command: PYTHONPATH=. /home/delete/nirs4all/nirs4all-studio/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_runs_engine_routing.py tests/test_runs_execution_backend.py tests/test_runtime_errors.py tests/test_spectra_perf.py tests/test_playground.py::TestStatisticsAndPCA::test_statistics_computation && PYTHONPATH=. /home/delete/nirs4all/nirs4all-studio/.venv/bin/python -m compileall -q api && ruff check api tests/test_runs_engine_routing.py tests/test_runs_execution_backend.py tests/test_runtime_errors.py tests/test_spectra_perf.py
evidence: requested engine, actual engine, fallback status, and RtError metadata survive route retries
remaining Studio compute paths are either runtime-backed or explicitly listed as blockers

gates.title: Web runtime contract and browser smoke
command: export PATH=/home/delete/.nvm/versions/node/v22.21.1/bin:$PATH; npm run typecheck && npm run test -- dagml-engine.rt-fallback.test.ts && npm run build && npm run build:single && node scripts/run-smokes.mjs rt-fallback
evidence: allowFallback=false is observable in Web runtime errors
served browser smoke covers fallback diagnostics
single-file build still carries runtime metadata

gates.title: dag-ml lockstep contracts against dag-ml-data
command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy -p dag-ml-core -p dag-ml-cli --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p dag-ml-core && DAG_ML_DATA_REPO={workspace_root}/_worktrees/INT-dmd python3 scripts/validate_contracts.py
evidence: shared contract artifacts validate against the sibling dag-ml-data integration tip
data-requirements consumers still compile and test

gates.title: dag-ml-data lockstep contracts against dag-ml
command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy -p dag-ml-data-core -p dag-ml-data-cli --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p dag-ml-data-core && DAG_ML_REPO={workspace_root}/_worktrees/INT-dagml python3 scripts/validate_contracts.py
evidence: shared contract artifacts validate against the sibling dag-ml integration tip
registry-backed model-input validation still passes

gates.title: Standalone migration toolbox smoke
command: PYTHONPATH=src /home/delete/.local/bin/pytest tests -q && python3 -m compileall -q src tests && ruff check src tests
evidence: legacy artifacts are never migrated in place
strict conversions refuse unsafe legacy data before output
best-effort conversions preserve opaque payloads with checksums

gates.title: Aggregation release lock validation
evidence: release manifest and lockfile agree with current member contract artifacts

gates.title: Post-flip default engine is dag-ml
command: from nirs4all.pipeline.engine import DEFAULT_ENGINE; assert DEFAULT_ENGINE == 'dag-ml', DEFAULT_ENGINE
evidence: This gate is expected to fail before the final cutover commit.
